facts.what: One beach ball (elastic, 10 kPa) dropped onto the castle, simulated as dry sand (left) or as damp, clay-like sand (plasticine, right), both 100 kPa
facts.dry: Dry sand has no cohesion: the castle top drops 76.7 model-mm with the ball and 37.6 without it (a no-ball control, means of 8 seeds), so about half of the collapse happens on its own.
facts.damp: The damp castle stands and only dents: 6.7 model-mm with the ball, 2.8 without it.
facts.sel: seed 0 for both; 7 of 8 dry and 8 of 8 damp seeds pass every check
facts.limit: A known limit: the very soft beach ball flattens on impact and stays flat.
